# WhatsApp errors: auth

A failed message names Meta's code. Find it below; a code that is not listed falls back to its family.

**The family:** WhatsApp refused the request because the access token or app permission is missing, expired, or insufficient. **Fix:** Reconnect WhatsApp in Settings so Whatsable can refresh the token. Then retry. **Who fixes it:** Whatsable. **Retry helps:** no.

Codes 200 to 299 (Permission denied) are in this family.

| Code | Title | Meaning | How to fix | Who fixes it | Retry helps |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | Unable to authenticate | WhatsApp refused the request because the access token or app permission is missing, expired, or insufficient. | Reconnect WhatsApp in Settings so Whatsable can refresh the token. Then retry. | Whatsable | no |
| `3` | Capability or permissions issue | WhatsApp refused the request because the access token or app permission is missing, expired, or insufficient. | Reconnect WhatsApp in Settings so Whatsable can refresh the token. Then retry. | Whatsable | no |
| `10` | Permission not granted | WhatsApp refused the request because the access token or app permission is missing, expired, or insufficient. | Reconnect WhatsApp in Settings so Whatsable can refresh the token. Then retry. | Whatsable | no |
| `190` | WhatsApp connection expired | The access token Whatsable holds for this WhatsApp number is expired or invalid, so WhatsApp refused the send. | Reconnect WhatsApp in Settings, then retry this step. | Whatsable | no |
| `200` | No access token provided | WhatsApp refused the request because the access token or app permission is missing, expired, or insufficient. | Reconnect WhatsApp in Settings so Whatsable can refresh the token. Then retry. | Whatsable | no |
